runtime_prompt_en:
Create a new photorealistic editorial photograph inside a rain-glazed rooftop greenhouse just after an evening gallery reception. The attached portrait is an appearance reference limited to visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture; the scene portrays an original fictional adult. One unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties stands on a low iron step to rehang a fallen strand of warm bulbs. She wears a bias-cut black satin midi dress beneath a light beige raincoat; both garments remain opaque and recognizable. Her purposeful overhead reach lengthens the covered silhouette and draws diagonal tension through satin and coat fabric while a few rain-damp strands settle against her neck. Mid-task, she turns an over-shoulder glance toward the camera with a restrained knowing half-smile. Subtle erotic charge built from converging cues is carried by the relationship among useful action, responsive fabric, damp texture, and brief reciprocal attention. Fogged panes, condensation bead trails, abandoned glasses, folded programs, and displaced chairs preserve the contrast between public-event polish and candid after-hours disarray. Frame a waist-height 50 mm medium-full portrait through a slightly open greenhouse door, retaining clear space above her raised hands and enough lower frame to show the iron step and believable footing. Amber bulbs refract through wet glass while cooler city spill defines her face, the garment folds, and the rigid iron geometry. Preserve natural shoulder alignment, realistic hands gripping the bulb strand, real pores, fabric grain, rain specks, and a plausible unguarded instant.

Avoid: unrealistic hands, distorted fingers, plastic-looking skin, over-processed retouching, fake-looking background, excessive HDR, broken facial features, illustration look, 3D render look
